plain.li: [!honey] I brought you something hot, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[!honey] Drink this while it's hot, it should help your throat.
[!honey] You sound awful, so I made you something hot.
Here, sit up a moment and drink this.
[tea] It's {DRINK}, breathe in the steam before you drink it.
[tea] A cup of {DRINK}, it should ease the cough a little.
[cocoa] Hot cocoa, drink it slowly while it's warm.
[honey] A spoonful of honey will soothe that throat.
[honey] Honey for your throat, take it slowly.

warm.li: I hate seeing you ill, so drink this and rest.

cheerful.li: Something for the patient, drink up!

gloomy.li: It won't cure you, but it might help a little.

plain.li: Hold still, I'm counting you.
That's this pen done, on to the next.
This one has filled out since spring.
Good teeth and a good coat on this one.
Easy now, I only want a look at you.
Count them twice, the old herders used to say.
[winter|fall] You'll want a thick coat for the winter.

warm.li: There you are, I was hoping to see you.

blunt.li: Stand still and let me count.

cheerful.li: Look at you all, a fine herd this year!

plain.li: {PET_nameDef} went for the raiders at {LINE} and brought one of them down.
{PET_nameDef} fought at {LINE} today and brought down at least one of them.
{PET_nameDef} gets the best of supper tonight, after what it did at {LINE}.
I didn't know {PET_nameDef} had it in it, but it held its own at {LINE}.
After the fight at {LINE} I checked {PET_nameDef} over from nose to tail.
{PET_nameDef} was in the thick of the fight at {LINE}, and came out of it standing.

warm.li: {PET_nameDef} came back to me after the fight at {LINE}, muddy and pleased with itself. I was so glad to see it.

blunt.li: {PET_nameDef} brought down a raider at {LINE}. Good animal.

gloomy.li: {PET_nameDef} fought at {LINE} today. Next time it might not come back, and I keep thinking about that.
